notes: This portable C++ TCK slice requests the content of one FOM module from a specific joined federate using the federate-scoped standard MIM interactions. It uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM declarations, HLAinteger32BE, HLAunicodeString, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, base FOM, standard MIM, an additional FOM module joined by the subject federate, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. The test sends the inherited target-federate parameter and validates the report's declared module indicator and XML content, reliable delivery, and cleanup; if the inherited target parameter is included in the report, it also checks that value. It makes no provider-specific header, registry, naming, or FOM-content assumptions.

api_surfaces.owner: IEEE 1516.1 C++ API and IEEE 1516.2 standard MIM
